results.title: Zebra
results.overview: A boy who keeps seeing a crying zebra encounters a girl who longs to be seen.

results.title: Vector
results.overview: In the remnants of human civilization, an exchange between a captor and a captive blurs perception, performance, and reality.

results.title: CRYONIC
results.overview: In the near future, two girls must escape their cult when they are selected to merge bodies with a frozen entity.

results.title: Struck
results.overview: Frankie has been hit by lightning seven times, often during milestones such as a first date, graduation, or a job interview.

results.title: Can You Keep a Secret?
results.overview: Unable to keep secrets and losing the people closest to her, Tanya turns to a therapist who offers an unconventional treatment involving a knife and a black candle.

results.title: The Knights of NYC
results.overview: A portrait of Jesse “Shortbread” Mooney and his life in New York City’s medieval combat community.

results.title: Cunning Folk
results.overview: A father brings home an unusual dagger, intending to end the suffering of his gravely ill son.

results.title: The Sound Between
results.overview: Penelope, a former dancer living with Alzheimer’s, revisits her youth while her daughter Olivia helps pack up their family home.

results.title: Handy Girl
results.overview: An urgent and punk cinematic diary where documentary and fiction collide. Guided by her handycam, a Buenos Aires underground actress and mother captures her daily fight for self-determination, turning low-fi filmmaking into political and artistic resistance.

results.title: The Writer 2
results.overview: A writer, who is a former pilot, faces difficulties while writing a new screenplay.

results.title: In The Flesh
results.overview: An old man recounts the strange encounter he had with a creature in the middle of the woods. He fears it has come to claim him.

results.title: Refuse to Yield the Realm
results.original_title: 战神戚继光之不让江山
results.overview: The story of the renowned Ming Dynasty general, Qi Jiguang, who fought against the Wakou pirates. He led the officers and soldiers of the "Qi Family Army" to overcome various obstacles and successfully reclaimed Hengyu Island, which had long been occupied by the Wakou.

results.title: The Killing Diamond
results.overview: Two brothers accept a easy heist job, but one of them has a twisted plan that's going to cost some lives.

results.title: FEROPOLIS
results.overview: For seven decades, FER has been a place where ideas become innovations, knowledge drives progress, and boundaries exist only to be pushed. This is not merely a story about the past, but about people who believed that knowledge could change the world  -  those who had the courage to imagine what did not yet exist and to create what was yet to come.

results.title: Manami Guid Mag **** sa Mansion
results.overview: During the American colonial period in Brgy. Paraiso, Sagay City, Negros Occidental, the American-owned Insular Lumber Company established one of the largest hardwood logging operations in the world under a government forest concession. The film follows Caloy, a young laborer sent to deliver the payroll to a hacendero’s mansion on the night a catastrophe descends upon Sagay. As it tears through the workers’ settlement, the hacendero couple remains sheltered inside their mansion.

results.title: American Voices 2026
results.overview: Over the past six years, a team of filmmakers has been following more than a dozen Americans in eight states across the U.S., charting their views about changes in the country and in their own lives. Now, a month before the midterm elections, how are these Americans — from a doctor to a pastor to a barber to a construction company owner to a retiree — feeling about the direction of the country? "American Voices 2026" asks how their hopes and fears have evolved amid another polarizing election season, a faltering economy, and a war with Iran that's now in its eighth month.

results.title: Kalpana Aur Yatharth
results.overview: The story of the film originated from real and fictional events revolves around the unreal world, through which a man embarks on an endless journey for his wife who left him.

results.title: A Friend, No Longer Here
results.overview: Ahmed moved back to Egypt from Saudi Arabia in 2017. That was the last time he saw his classmate and best friend. This evocative account of loss uses videos and an inner monologue to look back in time and, through six symbolic gifts, explores why some friendships fall apart and where the line between care and dependence lies.
